Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Quick check: accelerate the Redwood pilot or archive?

Hi Maria / Jamal —

Great talking earlier. Short recap + proposed next steps so we have a shared plan and nothing falls through the cracks: 

What we discussed (high level)
- Pilot goal: measure latency/cost for your microservices-backed chat assistant and validate embeddings for semantic search.
- Success metrics: avg gen latency < 300ms P95 (for 512 tokens); embed recall > 0.87 on your benchmark test; cost target ~ $0.02/1k tokens.
- Timeline you mentioned: target pilot start in the first week of August, ideally a 2-week run.

Next steps I proposed
1) We share pilot scope & MAP (attached) — includes test data slices, endpoints to integrate, and a lightweight eval harness.
2) You confirm technical contact for integration (requesting an SRE or backend engineer).
3) Procurement signs the SOW/PO or confirms billing path (I included a procurement stub for clarity).

Requested by end of week: please confirm the technical contact and whether Aug 2 as a kickoff looks feasible. If procurement needs a different cadence or paperwork, flag that and we’ll adapt.

Attachments: SaaSCo-MAP-v1.pdf (pilot MAP), pilot-scope.xlsx (scope + milestones)

If it helps, we can do a 30-min alignment with your SRE and Jamal next week.

Thanks —
Vivek

Hi Maria / Jamal —

Just nudging this thread — wanted to confirm whether Jamal can be the technical lead and whether procurement had any outstanding questions about the SOW/quote we sent.

If useful, I can:
- Do a 20-min call with Jamal to go through the integration checklist and test data surface.
- Provide a sample DocuSign SOW prefilled with the billing contact to speed procurement.

We have a small window in early August to get the pilot done before your next release freeze. If this timeline no longer works, totally fine — just let me know and I’ll archive the opportunity so I’m not pinging you repeatedly.

Thanks —

Subject: Final check — should I archive the pilot opportunity?

Hi all —

I realize calendars get busy — wanted to do one last check before I close the file on our side. Quick options: 

1) Accelerate: you confirm technical lead and procurement path this week and we keep the Aug 2 kickoff. I’ll send the prefilled SOW and calendar link for Jamal.
2) Pause/Archive: if timeline or priorities have shifted, say the word and I’ll archive the opportunity; I’ll re-open when the timing is right.

No hard feelings either way — just don’t want to keep following up if this isn’t a priority. If helpful, reply with a one-line status ("Go — we have Jamal and procurement" / "Not now — archive" / "Need more time — ping in 60 days").

Attachments (again): SaaSCo-MAP-v1.pdf, pilot-scope.xlsx

Thanks for making this easy to call.

— Vivek
